data.rationale: The proposal matches the core sequence (type city, select suggestion, SEARCH, open sort and filter), but it blurs activities with hotels, treats country as a separate parameter, and doesn't say how to apply the rating and sort or click the final Filter button, so an automation would have to guess at those parts.
